license_required.quote: The purpose of this chapter is to establish the title of "Mississippi Certified Interior Designer" and to restrict the use of this title to those persons having specific interior design education, experience and examination

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Architecture as defined in Section 73-1-3.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Architecture as defined in Section 73-1-3.

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Architecture as defined in Section 73-1-3.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant must exhibit to the regulatory board and IDAC the applicant's good standing in the profession and the applicant's moral character.

degree_required.value: a degree in interior design from a program accredited by the CIDA, a degree in architecture from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB), or a four-year degree in interior design from a college or university approved by the regulatory board
degree_required.quote: The applicant has a degree in interior design from a program accredited by the CIDA, a degree in architecture from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB), or a four-year degree in interior design from a college or university approved by the regulatory board.

accrediting_body.value: Council for Interior Design Accreditation (CIDA) or National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB)
accrediting_body.quote: a degree in interior design from a program accredited by the CIDA, a degree in architecture from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB)

degree_level.quote: a four-year degree in interior design from a college or university approved by the regulatory board

school_approval_basis.quote: a degree in interior design from a program accredited by the CIDA, a degree in architecture from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB)

credential_pegged.quote: the applicant must have passed the IDQE as administered by NCIDQ or its approved successor

tiers.quote: a degree in interior design from a program accredited by the CIDA, a degree in architecture from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB), or a four-year degree in interior design from a college or university approved by the regulatory board
Possession of a four-year degree in interior design from a nonaccredited program or another degree approved by the board and having passed all sections of the IDQE, or its successor

tiers.license_class: alternate eligibility (ten years experience, no degree required)
tiers.quote: Possession of ten (10) years of experience practicing in the profession of interior design and having passed all sections of the IDQE, or its successor.

required.quote: The applicant has a degree in interior design from a program accredited by the CIDA, a degree in architecture from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB), or a four-year degree in interior design from a college or university approved by the regulatory board. Additionally, the applicant must have passed the IDQE as administered by NCIDQ or its approved successor

experience_source.quote: The applicant has a degree in interior design from a program accredited by the CIDA, a degree in architecture from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB), or a four-year degree in interior design from a college or university approved by the regulatory board. Additionally, the applicant must have passed the IDQE as administered by NCIDQ or its approved successor

exams.name: Interior Design Qualification Examination (IDQE)
exams.notes: Administered by NCIDQ or its approved successor. Licensed architects and engineers in Mississippi must also pass the IDQE to be certified.
exams.quote: "IDQE" means the Interior Design Qualification Examination as prepared and administered by NCIDQ or its successor.

interval_years.quote: the biennial certification renewal fee as set by rules and regulations

required.quote: Each Mississippi Certified Interior Designer shall be required to meet the continuing education requirements established by the board and IDAC. The board and IDAC shall set a minimum requirement of continuing education for the biennial reporting period.

period_years.quote: The board and IDAC shall set a minimum requirement of continuing education for the biennial reporting period.

available.quote: The board and IDAC may accept applications for Mississippi certification from an interior designer in another jurisdiction pursuant to Section 73-73-7 or 73-73-9.

requirements.value: Applications accepted from interior designers in another jurisdiction under standard or alternate eligibility requirements. Military-trained applicants, military spouses, or persons who establish residence in Mississippi are subject to Sections 73-50-1 or 73-50-2.
requirements.quote: The issuance of a certification by reciprocity to a military-trained applicant, military spouse or person who establishes residence in this state shall be subject to the provisions of Section 73-50-1 or 73-50-2, as applicable.

exists.quote: "Interior Design Advisory Committee" or "IDAC" means the jurisdictional committee responsible for making recommendations to the board for implementing interior design legislation and making rules and regulations. IDAC is comprised of Mississippi Certified Interior Designers and reports to the board. Decisions and actions of IDAC are subject to ratification by the board through review and approval of IDAC's minutes.

name.quote: "Interior Design Advisory Committee" or "IDAC" means the jurisdictional committee responsible for making recommendations to the board for implementing interior design legislation and making rules and regulations.

authority.value: Makes recommendations to the board; decisions and actions of IDAC are subject to ratification by the board through review and approval of IDAC's minutes; IDAC may adopt rules and regulations subject to board approval; reviews and investigates charges against certified designers and makes findings of fact and recommendations to the board on disciplinary action
authority.quote: Decisions and actions of IDAC are subject to ratification by the board through review and approval of IDAC's minutes.

national_certification.value: National Council for Interior Design Qualification (NCIDQ)
national_certification.quote: "NCIDQ" means the National Council for Interior Design Qualification.

national_association.quote: "CIDA" means Council for Interior Design Accreditation (formerly known as "FIDER" or the "Foundation for Interior Design Education Research").

regulatory_model.quote: The purpose of this chapter is to establish the title of "Mississippi Certified Interior Designer" and to restrict the use of this title to those persons having specific interior design education, experience and examination

credential_type.quote: "Certificate" means the certificate issued by the board authorizing the holder of the certificate to use the title Mississippi Certified Interior Designer.

is_mandatory.quote: The purpose of this chapter is to establish the title of "Mississippi Certified Interior Designer" and to restrict the use of this title to those persons having specific interior design education, experience and examination

title_protection.quote: Offer to hold himself out as a Mississippi Certified Interior Designer, unless duly certified under this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: The purpose of this chapter is to establish the title of "Mississippi Certified Interior Designer" and to restrict the use of this title to those persons having specific interior design education, experience and examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions of the chapter or bylaws, rules, regulations, or standards of ethics pertaining to using the title Mississippi Certified Interior Designer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any of the provisions of this chapter, or the bylaws, rules, regulations or standards of ethics or conduct duly adopted and promulgated by IDAC pertaining to using the title Mississippi Certified Interior Designer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a certificate by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a certificate as a Mississippi Certified Interior Designer by fraud, deceit or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, malpractice, incompetence, or misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence, malpractice, incompetence or misconduct by a Mississippi Certified Interior Designer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional misconduct as defined by IDAC through bylaws, rules, regulations, and standards of conduct and ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any professional misconduct, as defined by IDAC through bylaws, rules and regulations and standards of conduct and ethics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the title Mississippi Certified Interior Designer on an expired certificate or while under suspension or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of the term Mississippi Certified Interior Designer on an expired certificate or while under suspension or revocation of a certificate unless such suspension or revocation is abated through probation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the title Mississippi Certified Interior Designer under an assumed or fictitious name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of the term Mississippi Certified Interior Designer under an assumed or fictitious name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted by any court of a felony, except culpable negligent manslaughter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted by any court of a felony, except conviction of culpable negligent manslaughter, in which case the record of conviction shall be conclusive evidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully misleading or defrauding any person employing the designer by any artifice or false statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully misleading or defrauding any person employing him or her as a Mississippi Certified Interior Designer by any artifice or false statement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having any undisclosed financial or personal interest that compromises the obligation to the client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having any undisclosed financial or personal interest which compromises his obligation to his client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being out of compliance with an order for support
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board may suspend the certificate of any person for being out of compliance with an order for support, as defined in Section 93-11-153

definition_quote.quote: "Mississippi Certified Interior Designer" means an interior design professional who holds a certification issued by the board. A certified interior designer shall not be considered to be a registered design professional as defined within the International Building Code or by building permit requirements.

credential_tier.quote: "Mississippi Certified Interior Designer" means an interior design professional who holds a certification issued by the board.

architect_pathway_available.quote: The applicant is a licensed architect in the State of Mississippi who has passed the IDQE as administered by NCIDQ or its approved successor

ncidq_exam_required.quote: the applicant must have passed the IDQE as administered by NCIDQ or its approved successor

value: Four-year interior design degree from board-approved college/university + IDQE
Four-year interior design degree from nonaccredited program + all sections of IDQE (alternate eligibility, application before July 1, 2013)
Ten years of experience in interior design practice + all sections of IDQE (alternate eligibility, application before July 1, 2013)
education_experience_pathways.quote: The applicant has a degree in interior design from a program accredited by the CIDA, a degree in architecture from a program accredited by the National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB), or a four-year degree in interior design from a college or university approved by the regulatory board. Additionally, the applicant must have passed the IDQE as administered by NCIDQ or its approved successor

compensation_disclosure_required.quote: A Mississippi Certified Interior Designer may not accept compensation for interior design services from more than one (1) party on a project unless the circumstances are fully disclosed to and accepted by all parties involved in the project. Any disclosure and agreement must be in writing.

conflict_of_interest_rules.quote: A Mississippi Certified Interior Designer may not solicit or accept compensation or gratuities from contractors, material or furniture suppliers, or manufacturer's sales representatives from endorsing their companies or specifying their products.

inactive_status_available.quote: Upon failure to renew a certificate during the month of January of the renewal year, the certificate shall be rendered inactive at midnight on January 31 of the renewal year. A person with an inactive status certification is not allowed to use the title of Certified Interior Designer.
